name: Flow
tagline: Tools for Steam games and game releases.
description: Flow is the home for Brlinkin tools: small apps that fix one specific problem with Steam games or game releases. No accounts, no telemetry, no hosted service. Find a tool, download the alpha, and follow the setup steps.
roadmap: Decky status panel: SteamOS validation (sideload alpha available)
Linux setup app: SteamOS validation (.deb, .rpm, and AppImage alpha available)
ReleaseGuard Windows app: signed build and GUI (unsigned .exe available)
